categories.main_business_segments: The company and its subsidiaries operate primarily in the manufacturing and sales of industrial abrasive grinding wheels, including general abrasive wheels and CBN abrasive wheels. The business is organized as a single manufacturing and sales segment focused on abrasive products used in various industries such as steel, automotive, shipbuilding, and precision machining.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies for producing general abrasive grinding wheels and CBN grinding wheels, including pressing and molding processes. Key raw materials include abrasive grains, glass fiber fabric, resin, and bonding agents. The company also invests in R&D to improve product quality and develop high-value-added products, supported by a dedicated technical research institute.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Major customers include large industrial companies such as POSCO, Hyundai Motor Company, SeAH Besteel, and Hyundai Heavy Industries. The products serve foundational industries like steel, automotive, shipbuilding, machinery, and precision processing sectors. The company maintains long-term supply contracts and stable relationships with these key customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities in South Korea (Pohang and Ansan) and Indonesia, with sales subsidiaries in Indonesia and Vietnam. Domestic sales constitute the majority of revenue, with export sales accounting for a smaller portion. The company targets both domestic and international markets, focusing on Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing abrasive grinding wheels from raw materials and supplying these products directly to industrial manufacturers. It sources key raw materials globally, especially abrasive grains, and delivers finished products to end users in heavy industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product quality, acquiring cutting-edge grinding technologies, and developing new high-value-added products such as piston rod finishing wheels and eco-friendly grinding stones. The company maintains a dedicated R&D center and invests approximately 0.99% of sales in research and development to sustain innovation and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of manufactured abrasive grinding wheels, including general and CBN types. The company sells products via direct contracts and supply agreements with major industrial customers, both domestically and internationally. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds the largest domestic market share in South Korea for abrasive grinding wheels and maintains strong brand recognition. It competes on quality, delivery reliability, and after-sales service. While specific competitors are not named, the company emphasizes its stable customer relationships and superior operational efficiency as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated sales of approximately 85.2 billion KRW, with a 2.16% increase from the previous year. Operating profit increased by 53.86%, and net profit surged by 394.64%, reflecting strong financial growth. The company maintains a solid financial structure with a low debt ratio of 11.27% and high liquidity ratios.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through high-quality abrasive products tailored to customer specifications, reliable on-time delivery, and comprehensive after-sales service. Its products are essential consumables in foundational industries, and the company leverages long-term trust relationships and continuous innovation to maintain market leadership and customer satisfaction.
